summary: Iter 8 focused on (A) static resilience via bundled salon.json + localStorage cache + background API sync and (B) BookingModal UX polish: dup-close hidden, clickable stepper (back only), animated success screen, .ics Add-to-Calendar, WhatsApp auto-open, Esc close. All 7 review-request items PASSED. Only one non-blocking console warning observed (React 'duplicate keys' during MenuSection/StylistsSection render).
action_items: MINOR: React console warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' fires repeatedly during initial render (seen 4-5x per page load). Likely in MenuSection/StylistsSection when merged live services collide with bundled static ids (or when categories iterate). Non-blocking but should be de-duped by using unique keys (e.g. `${s.id}-${idx}` or Set-dedupe by name). Repro: open home page, check console.
critical_code_review_comments: useSalonData.merge() merges by NAME which is correct, but stylists are replaced wholesale from API without name-based merge — if the backend ever returns a subset (< 6) of static stylists, static ones are lost until page reload. Consider merge-by-name for stylists too.
buildIcsDataUrl assumes b.time is HH:MM format and adds 1h fixed; multi-service bookings that realistically take longer will end at wrong DTEND. Cosmetic only.

BookingModal loads /api/stylists again on modal open (line 58), duplicating what useSalonData already fetched. Consider passing stylists via prop from Home.jsx (already available in useSalonData) to reduce round-trips.
React duplicate-key warning surfaces in production build — indicates two rendered elements share a key. Fix upstream to avoid subtle reconciliation bugs.
test_credentials: Not needed for this iteration — booking flow doesn't require auth.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 booking via /api/bookings for iter8@test.com to verify success screen + WhatsApp/ICS flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static data lives in /app/frontend/src/data/salon.json (178 services, 6 stylists). Loader at /app/frontend/src/lib/useSalonData.js caches to localStorage 'kbs_salon_cache_v1'. Cache only writes on successful API sync (blocked API → no cache write, correct behavior). BookingModal has data-testid stepper-{0..4}; disabled prop on future steps prevents click. Radix default close is hidden via CSS 'div[&>button.absolute]:hidden' on DialogContent — only 'booking-close-btn' is visible. Success screen has confirm-whatsapp-btn, add-to-calendar-btn (href starts data:text/calendar), confirm-close-btn. WhatsApp auto-open uses window.open with 900ms delay after successful booking submit.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification pass. All 7 target items in the review request PASSED: (1) Static menu renders with API blocked (Korean Combo/Haircut/Facial visible in DOM), (2) Cache populates with 178 services after live sync (kbs_salon_cache_v1), (3) merge-by-name works (backend_id populated on cached objects), (4) Exactly 1 visible close X in modal — Radix default (button.absolute) has display:none, (5) Clicking stepper-0 from step 2 jumps back; stepper-4 is disabled (future), (6) Success screen shows animated checkmark, summary card, Send-WhatsApp + Add-to-Calendar + Done — ICS href starts 'data:text/calendar', decoded content has 'BEGIN:VCALENDAR', 'DTSTART', 'SUMMARY:KBS Beauty Saloon', (7) Esc closes modal (modal count = 0), (8) WhatsApp auto-open triggered — window.open called with 'https://wa.me/919494542999?text=...' containing name/date/services/total.
